svg.aria-label: From brief to ranking: brief, build, launch, rank. The snag list: Hacked or outdated plugins, fixed with malware cleanup, plugin audit and hardening; Slow page-builder pages, fixed with hand-coded theme with lean assets; One page for every service, fixed with a page per service and per suburb; No structured data, fixed with json-ld on every template; Invisible in AI answers, fixed with entity-clear content that ai tools can cite; Redirects lost in a rebuild, fixed with full redirect map, checked before go-live
